inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies provided for review during today's inspection was missing the following policies:   Procedures for the release of children.   Illness and exclusion criteria.   Procedures for dispensing medication or a statement that medication is not dispensed.    Procedures for handling medical emergencies.    Discipline and Guidance policy.   Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activities. Parents Rights

Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include procedures for evacuating and relocating children who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: The home was not equipped with a working carbon detection system. Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the applicant unboxed a carbon detection system and installed it in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During today's inspection the following was observed:   Medication stored near an area designated for childcare use.   Cleaning supplies stored in areas designated for childcare use.   A mop bucket filled with water was observed outdoors.   A handsaw was stored in area that would be accessible to children.   Unmarked glass on sliding doors.   A propane tank was installed in the kitchen and used for indoor cooking.  A treadmill was stored in an area designated for childcare use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: There is no space designated for individual storage of items.

Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The evacuation and relocation diagram did not show the designated location inside the home where all adults and children take shelter from threatening weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §747.5007(4))
